name: Hermes Agent
description: Installs Hermes Agent (Nous Research) for the remote user, with optional plugins and agent skills.

plugins.description: Comma-separated list of Hermes plugins to install and enable (hermes plugins install ENTRY --enable). Each entry is a curated catalog name (e.g. snyk), an owner/repo shorthand or a Git URL. Skipped when empty.

skills.description: Comma-separated list of agent skill sources to install globally for Hermes Agent via the skills CLI (npm install -g skills). Each entry accepts owner/repo shorthand (e.g. vercel-labs/agent-skills) or a full GitHub URL. Node.js is installed on demand. Skipped when empty.
